name: Yuki o Miageru
source:
Two students have decided to pursue different universities.
They know they will be separated, but they must focus on their studies to be accepted.
Time passes quietly as they hold on to their unspoken feelings...

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/24742]Freem![/url]]
translation:
两名学生决定去不同的大学就读。
他们知道自己会被分开，但他们必须专注于学业才能被接受。
时间悄然流逝，他们怀揣着未言而喻的感情……
